seg: Hark, hark! the lark at heaven's gate sings,
His steeds to water at those springs
With every thing that pretty is,
With every thing that pretty is,

letras.autor: William Shakespeare (Cymbeline, II.3); música de Franz Schubert (Ständchen, D 889)
letras.fuente: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/william-shakespeare/cymbeline/text/act-2, Standard Ebooks (Cymbeline, acto II, escena 3), con los dos versos que Schubert repite escritos como se cantan, obtenido por el archivo
